blocks.prompt: 3 The number of bacteria in a culture currently is 1000. Three hours ago, it was 750. What was the number of bacteria five hours ago?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh growth ka sawal hai: \(\frac{dN}{dt} = kN\). Khaas baat yeh hai ke maazi (past) ka waqt poochha gaya hai.
Hum waqt 'abhi' se naapenge: abhi \(t = 0\), teen ghante pehle \(t = -3\), paanch ghante pehle \(t = -5\).
Diya kya hai? \(N(0) = 1000\), \(N(-3) = 750\).
Find kya karna hai? \(N(-5)\).
Plan: solution banayein, \(k\) nikalein, phir \(t = -5\) rakhein.
steps:
Diya gaya: abhi \(N(0) = 1000\), teen ghante pehle \(N(-3) = 750\); \(t\) ghanton mein, abhi se naapa gaya.
Maloom karna: \(N(-5)\).
Tareeqa: growth model \(\frac{dN}{dt} = kN\), \(k > 0\). Negative \(t\) ka matlab sirf guzra hua waqt hai; formula wohi rehta hai.

Differential equation hal karein
\[\int\dfrac{dN}{N} = \int k\,dt\]
\[N = ce^{kt}\]
\[N(0) = 1000 \Rightarrow c = 1000\]
\[N = 1000e^{kt}\]
Kyun: variables alag kar ke integrate kiya, \(e\) liya, aur \(t = 0\) par \(e^{0} = 1\) se \(c = 1000\) mila.

\(N(-3) = 750\) lagayein
\[750 = 1000e^{-3k}\]
\[e^{-3k} = \dfrac{3}{4}\]
\[k = \tfrac{1}{3}\ln\tfrac{4}{3} \approx 0.09589\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(\ln\) liya: \(-3k = \ln\frac{3}{4} = -\ln\frac{4}{3}\). Minus dono taraf se cancel hua aur \(k\) positive aaya, jo growth ke liye sahi hai.
Dhyan dein: kai students teen ghante pehle ko \(t = 3\) le lete hain; is se \(k\) negative aa jata hai aur jawab ulta ho jata hai.

\(N(-5)\) nikalein
\[N(-5) = 1000e^{-5k}\]
\[= 1000\left(e^{-3k}\right)^{5/3}\]
\[= 1000\left(\tfrac{3}{4}\right)^{5/3}\]
\[\approx 619.11\]
Kyun: \(e^{-5k} = (e^{-3k})^{5/3}\), aur \(e^{-3k} = \frac{3}{4}\) bilkul theek maloom hai, is liye round kiye hue \(k\) ki zaroorat nahi.

Tasdeeq
Paanch ghante pehle ka waqt 750 wali reading se do ghante pehle hai:
\[750\left(\tfrac{3}{4}\right)^{2/3} \approx 750(0.8255) \approx 619.1 \;\checkmark\]
Jawab 750 se kam hai, aur badhti hui aabadi mein pehle tadaad kam hi honi chahiye.
